name: genui-spectrum-openui
description: Part 03: the OpenUI Lang catalog (Zod + React) bundled for the browser, plus a Node checker the Python server calls.

scripts.build: esbuild app.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/openui-app.js --external:/shared/* --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --minify --log-level=warning && esbuild check.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/check.mjs --minify --external:/shared/* --log-level=warning && node prompt.mjs
